resources.string: Listening… tap to finish, or Cancel to discard the whole draft
Microphone permission is missing. Tap Enable; audio stays on this device.

Local model is not installed. Switch back to system recognition in Settings.
Results only fill the input box and are never sent automatically; Cancel discards the whole draft. Audio is never uploaded or saved; the ledger stores only duration, source and success.

Becomes available once a local model is installed; no silent fallback to system recognition.
